label: Pure Clan Lineage
description: Known descent within one clan line.

label: Mixed Clan Heritage
description: Ancestry from two or more clans.

label: Distant Clan Descendant
description: Remote ancestry with uncertain or diluted inheritance.

label: Hidden / Concealed Lineage
description: Ancestry intentionally hidden or unknown to the character.

label: Lost Bloodline
description: A lineage with very few or no known surviving members.

label: Adopted / Non-Biological Heir
description: Raised within a clan or family without biological descent.

label: Noble Family Heritage
description: Ancestry from a recognized political or noble family.

label: Ancient / Mythic Ancestry
description: Exceptional ancient lineage; must be rare and lore-validated.

label: Artificially Altered Heritage
description: Lineage altered through a documented experiment or procedure; use sparingly.

label: OC Heritage
description: Original lineage, explicitly labeled custom content.
